items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: No, not so hot in Paj. I mean, not like you're playing now, but he could get off a little, you know.

No, not so hot in Paj. I mean, not like you're playing now, but he could get off a little, you know. But he didn't play a good guy playing now. He's a good guy. He's a good guy. He's a good guy.
